name: Absolved from the Curse
source:
Luella is cursed.  But when two men appear out of nowhere with the promise to help her, she feels she must see if she can truly be separated from the one thing that makes her a monster.

[From Itch.io (removed)]
translation:
露埃拉受到诅咒。但当两名男子凭空出现，承诺帮助她时，她觉得自己必须确认，能否真正摆脱那个让自己成为怪物的东西。

（来源：已下架的itch.io页面）
